programme.title: Ugram
programme.desc: Shiva, a reckless CI officer, often lands himself in trouble. However, his impulsive actions take a dark turn when his family goes missing from a hospital after an accident.

programme.title: RDX
programme.desc: Robert, Dony and Xavier grow up together while honing their fighting skills. However, after an incident separates them for several years, an attack on their family reunites the three friends.

programme.title: Affraa Taffri
programme.desc: The small village of Vishrampur descends into chaos when its ailing leader, Trikamdas, wishes with his dying breath to see his granddaughter get married.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Bal Hanuman IV - Attack of the Universe
programme.desc: Chote Maharaj organises a kabaddi match between monkeys and crocodiles. However, the cunning crocodiles hatch a plan to revive the dreaded Demon crocodile king with the help of their new alien allies.

programme.title: Rowdy Sardar
programme.desc: A young man with a traumatic childhood rises up the ranks to become a dreaded gangster after being a victim of corruption and injustice.

programme.title: Uriyadi
programme.desc: The lives of four bachelors, who lead a carefree life, take a turn when they are dragged into a political fight. But, as time passes, they end up finding their mutual interconnections.

programme.title: F2: Fun and Frustration
programme.desc: Two young men hope to control their wives after their respective marriages. However, their chauvinistic attitude often lands them in hilarious situations.

programme.title: Ram Setu
programme.desc: Aryan, an archaeologist, is an atheist and publishes a controversial report on Rama Setu. Things take a turn when he sets out to prove its existence and becomes a believer in the process.

programme.title: Inspector Vijay
programme.desc: Vijay, an honest police officer, meets Samyukta at a cafe and falls in love with her. However, his life changes when he witnesses a kidnapping and ends up helping a lonely woman, Lavanya.

programme.title: Yudh Ek Jung
programme.desc: Chandu, a supermarket employee, encounters trouble after he decides to help Indu, an aspiring actor. But when he gets embroiled in a murder case, a dark secret from his past resurfaces.

programme.title: Bogan
programme.desc: A police officer probes a seasoned robber, oblivious to his hidden power, which allows him to possess people through eye contact.

programme.title: Salaar Part 1: Ceasefire
programme.desc: Just when the prince of Khansaar is about to rise to the throne, a plan of overthrowing him is exercised and only one man can help him retrieve power.

programme.title: Deewar Man of Power
programme.desc: Childhood friends Bujji and Chitti decide to meet after 12 years. Bujji, a gangster, attempts to murder Sivanna, not knowing that he is Chitti's brother.
